elementChain: main > h1 'The Amora Team' > seat cards; GET /api/org > roles[].holders[]; GET /api/content/team
repro: Create an empty MySQL schema, point DATABASE_URL at it, boot the server, open /team signed out. First boot seeds 17 circles, 25 org roles and 12 seat holders with is_example = 0.
personaLine: I deployed on Monday, sent the link to my board on Tuesday, and my village's team page was four strangers and a note saying one of them was away.

repro: Boot an empty fork and open /investor signed out. The page states +113% land value in 16 months, a $16M+ January 2026 appraisal, a 19.6% 15-year IRR and a $5M Phase 1 raise. No admin route reads or writes these constants.
personaLine: I showed an investor my own site and it told her my land had appreciated 113% in sixteen months. I have owned it for three weeks.

repro: On a deployment with no Resend key, post password/email/name to /api/admin/bootstrap. Response carries emailed:true; the server log on the same request reads '[RESEND] API key not set, skipping email'.
personaLine: It told me the founder's link was emailed. I waited two days for it.

repro: Run the runbook's own command, with or without --dry. It exits 1: 'This script does not know about 5 module(s) the server offers: resources, crowdpool, introductions, governance, hypha.' Nothing is enabled.
personaLine: I followed the runbook and the command told me it was out of date. I do not know which modules I now have.

repro: Boot an empty fork (forum and governance ship off) and open /propose signed out. It reads 'Start a proposal' then 'Reach out to the admin team, or make a proposal to initiate it in your village.'
personaLine: It told me to make a proposal. I clicked the page where you make proposals and it told me to make a proposal.
